title: Dynamic Domain Links Substrate Binding and Catalysis in the Factor-Inhibiting-HIF-1.
authors: Martin, Cristina B; Taabazuing, Cornelius Y; Knapp, Michael J
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学网络模型和酶学实验研究FIH酶100s环的动态铰链残基Tyr102在底物结合与催化偶联中的作用，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系（FIH与HIF-1α/CTAD底物），但核心是蛋白-蛋白/小分子底物互作而非TF-DNA结合，且方法以实验为主、仅辅以粗粒化网络模型，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: The interplay between active-site chemistry and functionally relevant enzyme motions can provide useful insights into selective enzyme modulation. Modulation of the hypoxia-sensing function of factor-inhibiting-HIF-1 (FIH) enzyme is a potential therapeutic strategy in disease states such as ischemia and cancer. The hypoxia-sensing function of FIH relies in major part on the tight coupling of the first half of the catalytic mechanism which involves O(2) activation and eventual succinate production to the second half which involves HIF-1alpha/CTAD substrate hydroxylation. In this study, we demonstrate the role of a loop hinge domain in FIH (FIH102-118) called the 100s loop in maintaining this particular tight coupling. Molecular dynamics patterns from Gaussian Network Model (iGNM) database analysis of FIH identified the 100s loop as one dynamic domain containing a hinge residue (Tyr102) with a potential substrate positioning role. Enzymological and biophysical studies of the 100s loop point mutants revealed altered enzyme kinetics with the exception of the conservative FIH mutant Y102F, which suggests a sterics-related role for this residue. Removal of the bulk of Tyr102 (Y102A) resulted in succinate production, autohydroxylation, and an O(2) binding environment comparable to wild-type FIH. However, the HIF-1alpha/CTAD substrate hydroxylation of this mutant was significantly reduced which implies that (1) the FIH loop hinge residue Tyr102 does not affect O(2) activation, (2) the stacking steric interaction of Tyr102 is important in substrate positioning for productive hydroxylation, and (3) Tyr102 is important for the synchronization of O(2) activation and substrate hydroxylation.
abstract_zh: 活性位点化学与功能相关酶运动之间的相互作用可为选择性酶调节提供有用见解。调节缺氧诱导因子抑制酶（factor-inhibiting-HIF-1, FIH）的缺氧感应功能是缺血和癌症等疾病状态下的潜在治疗策略。FIH的缺氧感应功能主要依赖于催化机制前半部分（涉及O(2)激活及最终琥珀酸产生）与后半部分（涉及HIF-1alpha/CTAD底物羟基化）的紧密耦合。在本研究中，我们展示了FIH中一个称为100s环的环铰链结构域（FIH102-118）在维持这种特定紧密耦合中的作用。通过高斯网络模型（Gaussian Network Model, iGNM）数据库分析FIH的分子动力学模式，识别出100s环为一个动态结构域，其中包含一个具有潜在底物定位作用的铰链残基（Tyr102）。对100s环点突变体的酶学与生物物理研究表明，除保守的FIH突变体Y102F外，酶动力学发生改变，这提示该残基具有与空间效应相关的角色。去除Tyr102的大部分侧链（Y102A）导致琥珀酸产生、自羟基化及O(2)结合环境与野生型FIH相当。然而，该突变体的HIF-1alpha/CTAD底物羟基化显著降低，这意味着：(1) FIH环铰链残基Tyr102不影响O(2)激活，(2) Tyr102的堆叠空间相互作用对底物定位以实现有效羟基化至关重要，以及(3) Tyr102对O(2)激活与底物羟基化的同步化具有重要作用。
